policy: Use every one of the 48 records in frozen order and preserve every attempt, including failures.
Freeze candidate code and evaluation code before inference. No semantic prompt or routing edits based on these results in this comparison.
Primary comparison is baseline 4B versus candidate 4B. Candidate 8B is secondary; default remains 4B, no model selection based on held-out results.
No expected labels enter model prompts. Evaluation happens after raw model outputs are saved.
Code changes, decoder constraints and retry policy are a bundle; changes in call order alter per-call seeds. Do not attribute differences to one isolated cause.
Do not claim production acceptance from this experiment. Report all primary outcomes even when they worsen.
predeclared_annotation_audit: After code freeze, inspect whether review_required labels conflate uncertain meaning/authorship with missing recurrence identity. Do not edit frozen labels or primary scorer. If ambiguous, retain primary result and report separately labeled sensitivity/unscored interpretation.
primary_outcomes: supported recurring themes delivered / 4 provisional expected recurring themes
delivered cards contradicting provisional labels, plus unscored/ambiguous cards separately
expected intents with aligned evidence/class/origin/new-demand flag / 54 provisional expected intents
sources requiring human review / 48 (v1 post-hoc proxy versus candidate materialized queue; not identical measurements)
secondary_outcomes: first-pass and final extraction contract validity
repair calls and total model calls
limitations: All 48 cases and labels are AI-authored synthetic examples; no human gold or corporate data.
Quote/class alignment cannot establish faithful paraphrase; review actual titles and statements manually.

Implementer/coordinator did not read case texts or labels before freeze. Dataset author subsequently implemented a generic decoder and fixed field schemas without consulting holdout; this is limited separation, not an external independent audit.
One ordered batch, one seed schedule, two small quantized open models on one Mac; no statistical or production prevalence claim.
No audio/image pipeline, corporate ACL integration, business effect or weight training is tested.
